name: DAOKI CNC Shield V3.0 kit
notes: Includes Arduino-compatible Uno, CNC Shield V3, 4 DRV8825 drivers, heatsinks, jumper caps, and USB cable.

name: STEPPERONLINE NEMA 17 stepper motor, 3-pack
notes: Build uses 2 motors; this listing includes 3.

name: ANNIMOS 20kg metal gear servo
notes: Pen lift servo.

name: GT2 belt, pulley, idler, tensioner, and clamp kit
notes: Buy 2. Each kit has 5m of 6mm GT2 belt, 20T pulleys, idlers, tensioner springs, clamp blocks, and wrench.

name: uxcell 625ZZ bearings, 25-pack
notes: Build uses 24 bearings.

name: 3030 aluminum extrusion, 39.4 inch, 10-pack
notes: Cut into the frame and gantry pieces.

name: 3030 corner bracket + M6 T-nut connector kit
notes: Includes 3030 corner brackets, M6 T-nuts, M6 x 12 bolts, and wrench.

name: M3 screw/nut/washer assortment
notes: Small toolhead, cart, servo, and motor hardware.

name: M4 screw/nut/washer assortment
notes: Belt clamp hardware.

name: M5 screw/nut/washer assortment
notes: Roller and pulley stack hardware.

name: M6 screw/nut/washer assortment
notes: Optional/extra M6 hardware. The connector kit already includes the main M6 x 12 frame bolts.

name: IRLZ44N logic-level N-channel MOSFET
notes: Servo anti-twitch power switch.

name: Aluminum cutting blade and paraffin wax
notes: Optional extrusion cutting helpers.

name: Assumed project supplies
notes: Breadboard, 220 ohm resistor, 10k ohm resistor, bench power supply, external 5V source, pen/pencil, spring, zip tie, and jumper wires.

name: Arduino Uno-compatible board
notes: Included in the electronics kit.

name: CNC Shield V3
notes: Plugs into the Uno.

name: DRV8825 motor driver
notes: Kit includes 4; this build uses 2. Set current limit to about 0.45-0.5A.

name: Arduino USB cable
notes: Included in the electronics kit.

name: 20kg servo
notes: Pen lift servo.

name: Servo horn
notes: Use the servo's included horn.

name: NEMA 17 stepper motor
notes: CoreXY motor A and motor B.

name: GT2 timing belt
notes: Buy 2 kits so each motor gets its own 5m belt.

name: GT2 20T drive pulley, 6mm belt width
notes: Mounted to the two stepper shafts.

name: GT2 idler pulley
notes: Build uses 6 toothed-style idlers and 2 toothless/smooth-style idlers. Confirm the exact pulley style in the kit before ordering.

name: GT2 aluminum timing belt clamp
notes: Included with the GT2 kit. Mounted to the printed belt clamp mount.

name: 625 bearing
notes: Used in rollers and bearing stacks.

name: 3030 aluminum extrusion, length pieces
notes: 1m pieces before cutting.

name: 3030 aluminum extrusion, width pieces
notes: 1m pieces before cutting.

name: 3030 aluminum extrusion, gantry piece
notes: Cut from extrusion stock. Use the gantry jig or cut off 58.2mm.

name: 3030 T-nut
notes: Use one with each M6 x 12 frame bolt. Gantry extrusion mount ones are optional and not counted.

name: Extrusion bracket
notes: Metal brackets for frame corners.

name: M6 x 12 bolt
notes: Used wherever a T-nut is used.

name: M6 x 30 bolt
notes: Optional if additional gantry-to-cart T-nuts are not desired.

name: M6 washer
notes: Optional, used with M6 x 30.

name: M5 x 45 bolt
notes: Back corner brackets, bottom of toolhead cart, and Y-cart pulleys.

name: M5 x 50 bolt
notes: Y-cart rollers and upper rollers of the toolhead.

name: M5 nut
notes: On cart bottoms and roller stacks.

name: M5 washer
notes: Used with M5 roller hardware.

name: M4 x 12 bolt
notes: Secures belt clamp onto belt clamp mount.

name: M4 nut
notes: Behind belt clamp mount.

name: M4 washer
notes: Behind belt clamp.

name: M3 x 6 bolt
notes: Pencil block pencil clamp.

name: M3 x 10 bolt
notes: Stepper motors and belt clamp mount.

name: M3 x 16 bolt
notes: Servo/toolhead hardware; 8 rigidity screws are optional.

name: M3 x 25 bolt
notes: Y carts for securing upper mold. Optional.

name: M3 nut
notes: Two embedded in belt mount, two on M3 x 16 servo mount.

name: M3 washer
notes: Small fastener washers.

name: Breadboard
notes: Easier interface for servo/MOSFET wiring.

name: Jumper wires
notes: Servo power circuit and CNC shield to breadboard wiring. Mostly long male-to-female wires.

name: IRLZ44N logic-level N-channel MOSFET
notes: Switches servo ground/power to prevent boot twitch. Logic-level equivalent is okay.

name: 220 ohm resistor
notes: Between D11/Z-limit signal and MOSFET gate.

name: 10k ohm resistor
notes: Gate pulldown to ground.

name: External 5V power source
notes: Powers servo through breadboard rails.

name: 12V bench power supply
notes: Powers the CNC shield/motors. Set current low at first during testing.

name: Pen or pencil
notes: For pens, remove the ink cartridge and use the pen adapter.

name: Spring for pencil mount
notes: OD less than 12mm, height around 30mm.

name: Zip tie
notes: 4 inch zip tie for securing servo wire onto aligner.

name: Aluminum cutting blade
notes: Optional, cleaner extrusion cuts. Prefer negative-angle TCG for nonferrous aluminum.

name: Paraffin wax block
notes: Optional cutting helper for extrusion.
